annotation.title_clean: Commission Implementing Decision (EU) 2026/193 of 28 January 2026 amending Implementing Decision (EU) 2021/1182 as regards harmonised standards for neurosurgical implants, biological evaluation of medical devices, clinical investigation, non-active surgical implants, sterilization, biocompatibility of breathing gas pathways and small-bore connectors
annotation.title_en: Commission Implementing Decision (EU) 2026/193 of 28 January 2026 amending Implementing Decision (EU) 2021/1182 as regards harmonised standards for neurosurgical implants, biological evaluation of medical devices, clinical investigation, non-active surgical implants, sterilization, biocompatibility of breathing gas pathways and small-bore connectors
annotation.venue: Official Journal of the European Union
annotation.summary_en: EU Commission Implementing Decision amending Decision 2021/1182 to add references of newly revised harmonised standards (implants, biocompatibility, sterilization, clinical investigation, connectors) supporting the Medical Devices Regulation 2017/745, conferring presumption of conformity from publication. No AI or robotics content.
key_provisions_or_claims: Adds entries 37–48 of harmonised standards to the Annex of Implementing Decision (EU) 2021/1182
Compliance with listed standards gives presumption of conformity with Regulation (EU) 2017/745
Covers neurosurgical implants, hip and knee implants, sterilization, breathing gas pathway biocompatibility, small-bore connectors
Enters into force on the day of publication in the Official Journal
